title: Workout Plan BC She Said No 😭🥀
author: urlocalbaker
desc:
This program splits up the different muscle groups to optimize growth of each in a specified manner. I would have done four days, but it would have taken forever in there gym each day, this I feel is much more manageable. 

Good for really anyone from a beginner to an expert, just be sure to watch your form and get lots of rest (and 150+ min moderate cardio!) please!

You can do this 5 days in a row, or take a day off in between.
